source: Status lines of the sim commands' text mirror, written by hand from outside the code under test. Each verdict comes from the scene's oracle or record: cotter-hook every hook INSERTS and cotter-hook-sharp TRAPPED (packages/sim/test/goldens/cotter-insert-oracle.json, hook_fit.py), slug measured 91 of 128 against the declared 126 of 128 (packages/sim/records/slug-trials.json exitRow), davit-mini-15in 0 real fails and 0 left-right contacts (packages/sim/records/davit-sweep.json), slug-vend1 and part.probe declare nothing. Each command makes one comparison, measured against declared, and counts it once under its verdict. The target is empty while --scene stands in for a build.
